The 7 collapses and 1 drop-FP reconcile cleanly against existing ledger entries with NO new entries (lastSeenRun bumps only). realizableSolvency invariant (DEDUP-COL-004) NOT re-escalated — folds into acknowledged M-02 / QA-08 per MEMORY. No fixed finding reappeared; no regression.

documentationCheck.result: NOT-BLESSED — edge is not explicitly documented as intended
documentationCheck.iYieldStrategyNatSpec: IYieldStrategy.sol L34-41 documents relinquishPrincipal as: 'Write down the caller's own recorded principal by `amount`, WITHOUT touching the underlying vault's shares (no redeem/withdraw/transfer). Decrements both clientBalances[token][msg.sender] and totalDeposited[token], preserving the invariant totalDeposited == Σ clientBalances. Intended for a principal-only client (e.g. the stable-staker) to release dormant principal so the corresponding vault value flows to yield ON RECOVERY rather than remaining a principal claim. Over-requests are capped to the caller's available principal.' — This blesses the share-untouched write-down and the value-to-yield re-attribution, but the phrase 'flows to yield on recovery' PRESUMES a surviving recovery path (remaining clients to whom the value re-attributes). It does NOT document the totalDeposited==0-with-shares case where no client remains, the residual is FROZEN by the _skimSurplus td==0 early-return, and the entire residual becomes capturable by the FIRST subsequent depositor via totalBalanceOf = totalValue*principal/totalDeposited inflation. The orphan + re-capture edge is unflagged.
documentationCheck.designDecisions: No designDecision blesses this. designDecision #2 ('Principal is decremented by REQUESTED amount on withdraw, not RECEIVED amount; any shortfall accrues to protocol') is the requested-not-received rule on the WITHDRAW path — it covers shortfall accrual to protocol, NOT relinquish-to-zero residual orphaning to the next depositor. The other 4 designDecisions (market-based AMM interaction, bidirectional route invariant, slippage bps, two-phase withdrawal) are unrelated.
documentationCheck.systemAssumptions: No systemAssumption covers this. The 5 systemAssumptions (route population, Curve Router trust, monotonic non-decreasing share price, standard ERC20 no-hooks, vault-owner-acts-in-best-interest) do not address the totalDeposited==0 orphan/re-capture sequencing.
documentationCheck.docsAndClaudeMd: lib/reflax-yield-vault/CLAUDE.md and docs/ contain NO mention of relinquish, orphaned residual, or the totalDeposited==0-with-shares edge. The `clientPrincipal == 0 || totalDeposited == 0` early-return appears at docs/UniswapV4AccountingBugFixPlan.md:311 as a surplus-skip GUARD, not as a blessed orphan-residual design choice; the relinquish primitive (story-045) postdates the IYieldStrategy NatSpec and these docs.
